scope: Independent native-OMML layout and renderer prototypes; no final manuscript modified

findings.issue: Explicit roman labels/operators appear italic and letter-spaced in LibreOffice
findings.cause: LibreOffice does not honor Pandoc m:sty=p as expected; \mathrm splits alphabetic runs
findings.verified_fix: Use \text{TP}/TN/FP/FN/dev/std/corr/fixed/equal/or for named labels; for explicit plain alphabetic runs normalize m:sty=p to m:nor and merge adjacent alphabetic text runs, excluding m:scr calligraphic runs

findings.cause: LibreOffice converts m:m to MathML mtable/StarMath matrix and discards m:mcJc alignment and cGp settings
findings.verified_fix: DOCX should still normalize mcPr child order=count,mcJc. For renderer-stable exact relation alignment prefer separate complete native math row fragments with paragraph tabs; eqArr is compact but centers rows independently in LO

findings.issue: Per-run font11 and normal/paragraph-marker11 do not produce math11 in LibreOffice
findings.cause: OMML import initializes Math object BaseFontHeight=12 independently of those values
findings.verified_fix: Task-local LibreOffice PDF profile /org.openoffice.Office.Math/StandardFormat BaseSize=11 renders root letters exactly11.0pt; BaseSize12 for main. Word source can independently retain standard Cambria Math and proper style sizes

findings.issue: ODT BaseFontHeight change alone still appears12pt
findings.cause: Parent draw:frame cached width/height retain original scale
findings.verified_fix: ODT-only alternative: modify every object BaseFontHeight11 AND scale its draw:frame width/height by11/12; measured10.99pt. Direct profile is simpler and avoids baseline/cache risks

not_recommended: Changing the math font name alone: Cambria-vs-LatinModern did not repair LO math style
Adding borderless3-column equation tables without sufficient number-column width: prototype(10) wrapped in0.42in
Claiming direct Word/WPS rendering was tested: neither application was available
fonts: Standard Cambria Math is a conservative DOCX portability choice; PDF LO uses Liberation Serif/OpenSymbol after OMML import
